errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are rotated 90 degrees, not written vertically (i.e., one character stacked on top of another). While the orientation is vertical, the term 'изписани вертикално' is ambiguous and less precise than 'rotated'.
The blue line for 'Вътрешен транспорт' starts exactly at the 100 mark on the y-axis in 1990. Using the word 'около' (around) is an unnecessary generalization when a precise value is clearly visible.
The blue line ends around 2021 at a value of approximately 122, which is visibly above the 120 grid line. Describing it as 'близо до 120' (close to 120) is an underestimate.
The orange line starts at a value visibly above 120, at approximately 121-122. Describing the starting point as 'около 120' (around 120) is an underestimate.
